verdict.rationale: Vanta documents Custom Tests, which turn data pushed from homegrown apps into pass/fail evidence (vanta-docs-2). Its GRC marketing refers to cross-mapping controls across pre-built frameworks 'or ones you've customized' and to bringing your existing program into Vanta (vanta-docs-12, vanta-docs-33, vanta-docs-25). Custom frameworks are only implied, though, and creating custom controls with their own evidence requirements is never explicitly documented. Missing for 10: explicit docs on creating a fully custom framework from scratch, documented custom control creation, defining custom evidence requirements per control, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
